verdict.rationale: Windmill's flows support parallelism, branching, and fault-tolerant orchestration (windmill-docs-5, windmill-docs-12), which implies capability to iterate/process many items in a flow, but no evidence explicitly documents a for-loop/bulk-iteration step, batch processing UI, or examples of running an operation across a large item set. missing for 10: explicit for-loop/iterator flow step documentation, evidence of scaling to large item counts, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk operation performance.
